artifacts.summary: Adds a shared session-scoped expense/category cache (plus a full-list category cache for History) so Home, History, and Reports stop redundantly re-fetching, fixes History's raw-category-id fallback, and makes Reports month/year stepping instant from already-fetched data. 12 ACs, 10 offline / 2 interactive (staging).
